86239: Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought.
86241: Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin. She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector.
88202: A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru.
88203: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than Tokaku is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.
88204: Hashiri Nio is an energetic and upbeat girl with a knack for peeping into other people's businesses. Despite being a part of the Black Class group, she is also affiliated with the academy in some way.
88205: Isuke is a truly sadistic girl who is always shown to be with clothing that show her stomach. She is also very blunt and quick to express her opinion, and likes to command other people, such as making Haruki call her "Isuke-sama".
88207: A girl with glasses who insists of being the 'rep' of everything, such as Black Class' class representative. She is shown to use grenades as a weapon.
88208: Shiena seems to have a normal personality compared to the rest of the members of Class Black. Although she is somewhat scatterbrained and forgetful, she is also strict at times, as shown when directing the play in Episode 5.
88209: Kirigaya Hitsugi is a girl who has the body of an elementary school student. She has a bad sense of direction, as demonstrated when she gets lost on her way to Myoujou Academy.
88210: He is the homeroom teacher of Haru and Azuma for the Black Class. Ataru is a young and friendly teacher wanting his students to think of him as a big brother.

88212: Tomboyish yet fashionable girl who is always shown eating snacks. Haruki is the typical lazy student who sleeps at class and is always looking for thrills, but is very sensitive about her family, which is full of siblings.
88213: Suzu is generally calm, affable and knowledgeable in many subjects.
88214: Takechi Otoya is an extremely playful girl with a rather intrusive personality. She likes to tease others, but her actions are seen as borderline bullying.

88216: Mako Azuma is the aunt of Tokaku Azuma as well as the younger twin sister of Karami Azuma. She was entrusted by her sister to take care of Tokaku when she died.
145089: The mysterious chairwoman of Myōjō Academy and Nio's superior.
